description: Realized APY for Base vaults and lending markets: the APY depositors actually earned over 7 and 30 days, read from on-chain share prices, next to the quoted APY, with a verdict (matches, overstated, understated) and a risk score. Useful for finding the best yields on Base and spotting advertised yields that are not being paid. Ids work with every other route. 404 for unknown paths and 400 for invalid arguments, before any payment; 503 while data refreshes; charged only for a 200. Price: $0.01 USDC on Base (x402), charged only for a successful answer.

asset.description: Token symbol, e.g. USDC or WETH.

realized_only.description: Only opportunities with a realized on-chain APY.

risk_max.description: Maximum risk score (0-100, lower is lower modelled risk).

sort.description: Order: risk_adjusted (default) ranks by opportunity score; realized_apy by the 30-day realized APY; sustainable_apy by the APY expected once incentives fade.

name: get_yields
